blurb_title: A secrets store has to do two things at once: be secure, and come back.
blurb_1: This guide builds OpenBao as a single node on a VM – Raft, Shamir, TLS, systemd hardening, daily snapshots to a NAS. Ansible installs, OpenTofu configures, and the few steps that have to stay manual are laid out as a runbook.
blurb_2: With what OpenBao does differently from Vault: no APT repo, no mlock, no snapshot inspect, no unauthenticated generate-root endpoints. And a disaster recovery onto an empty VM that explains why it takes two sets of unseal keys, one after the other.
